items.title: two std blanket arms on `Slot` — A165's `impl Option<type V: Slot> with Slot` and `impl type S: Flow<Option<View>> with Slot` — cost 0.2–0.7% of EVERY web program's check (reactive-ui x1.0068, ssr x1.0064, router x1.0063, walkthrough x1.0033, canvas x1.0030) although no measured program places an optional child: a hole's `Slot` question re-proves each candidate arm per site
items.discussion: store-49 (Order 49): A165; M120 (the std growth tax, the class); M111 (impl selection re-proved every blanket chain per site — the same shape on the method path); M123 (the bound audit's memo)
items.body: Measured at next @6bae4173 (release, instructions:u, `scripts/ci-local.sh perf`) against the same tree with A165's two commits reverted: reactive-ui 1,867,497,612 vs 1,854,800,114 (x1.0068), ssr x1.0064, router x1.0063, walkthrough x1.0033, canvas x1.0030, todo x1.0021, fullstack x1.0020, browser x1.0016; math, watch, rpc and genapp flat. Two impl arms costing up to 0.7% of a check means the element-syntax hole check asks `Slot` of every candidate impl per hole (each with a bound to prove: `V: Slot`, `S: Flow<Option<View>>`), the way M111 found the method path re-proving blanket chains per site. Doors: (a) rank/answer the hole's `Slot` question once per (hole type) through M123's memo or a per-type cache in the UI check; (b) cheap pre-filter on the subject's head constructor before the bound is proved (an `Option` arm is asked only of `Option` subjects). Measure first: `VILAN_PHASE_TIMING` on reactive-ui at 6bae4173 vs the revert. The ci bumps taken at 6bae4173 (nine rows, item M120) are the interim; the reference class is re-taken at the Order 49 seal. Sizing S–M; solver (impl_select / the UI checks), wave 2.
